Class KeyValuePartTreeQuery

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.keyvalue.repository.query.KeyValuePartTreeQuery
All Implemented Interfaces:
RepositoryQuery
Direct Known Subclasses:
CachingKeyValuePartTreeQuery
public class KeyValuePartTreeQuery extends Object implements RepositoryQuery
RepositoryQuery 实现通过预定义的 AbstractQueryCreator 从 PartTree 派生查询。
Author:
克里斯托夫·施特罗布，奥利弗·吉尔克，马克·帕卢赫
